instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides. Step one foot forward and the other back, resting on the ball of the rear foot.
2. Bend both knees to lower straight down until the front thigh is parallel to the floor and the rear knee hovers above the ground.
3. Keep your torso upright and the front knee tracking over your foot.
4. Push through the front heel to drive back up and extend both legs.
5. Finish all reps on one side, switch legs, then Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest up and core braced to avoid leaning forward.
2. Keep the front knee in line with the toes, not collapsing inward.
3. Move straight up and down rather than pushing the front knee far forward.
4. Use a stance length that lets both knees bend to about 90 degrees.
name: Kettlebell split squat

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
2. Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
3. Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping knees tracking over your toes.
4. Drive through your heels to stand back up and fully extend your legs.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your knees in line with your toes to prevent inward collapse.
2. Inhale as you lower and exhale as you drive up.
3. Keep your chest up and back flat throughout.
4. Press through the heels to engage glutes and quads.
name: Kettlebell squats

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell at shoulder height with the bell balanced upside down over your fist. Keep your wrist straight.
2. Brace your core and grip the handle hard to keep the bell stable.
3. Press the kettlebell straight overhead until your arm is fully extended.
4. Pause briefly with the bell balanced over a vertical forearm.
5. Lower it back to shoulder height under control, keeping the bottoms-up position.
6. Finish all reps, switch arms, then Repeat.
tips:
1. Grip the handle as hard as possible to stabilize the bell.
2. Start light to master the balance and control.
3. Keep the wrist straight and the forearm vertical throughout.
4. Brace your core to resist leaning to the side.
name: Kettlebell Standing Bottoms-up One Arm Shoulder Press

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell racked at one shoulder. The bell rests against the back of your wrist with the palm facing in and the elbow down.
2. Brace your core and keep your wrist straight.
3. Press the kettlebell straight overhead until the arm is fully extended.
4. Lower the kettlebell back to the racked position under control.
5. Finish all reps, switch arms, then Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep a neutral wrist to avoid strain.
2. Press without using leg drive or momentum.
3. Exhale as you press up and inhale as you lower.
4. Brace your core to resist leaning away from the load.
name: Kettlebell strict press

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell at your side in one hand with the arm extended.
2. Brace your core to keep your torso level against the offset load.
3. Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
4. Drive through your heels to stand back up, keeping your back straight.
5. Finish all reps, switch the kettlebell to the other hand, then Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso square and avoid leaning toward the weighted side.
2. Keep the knees tracking over the toes.
3. Brace the core hard to resist sideways bending.
4. Use a weight that lets you keep your shoulders level.
name: Kettlebell suitcase squat
